# Google Search Quality Rater Guidelines (unofficial machine-readable mirror)

> Google's Search Quality Evaluator Guidelines ("General Guidelines", the human quality rater guideline), version 2025-09-11, converted from the official PDF into Markdown, plain text, JSON and HTML so agents can read, grep and cite it. The text is (c) Google LLC; this mirror is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Official PDF: https://static.googleusercontent.com/media/guidelines.raterhub.com/en//searchqualityevaluatorguidelines.pdf

Version facts: version date 2025-09-11, 182 PDF pages, sha256 46aa9ea1fd004a09d68ececd7acdb18ec505061f52598fa69a856dfea94a6a06. The file VERSION holds these three values (date, source URL, sha256), one per line.

How to use:
- Search: grep markdown/sections/*.md or text/qrg.txt. Every PDF page starts with the marker `<!-- page N -->` (same format in Markdown and text), so the nearest marker above a match is the page to cite.
- Structure: json/qrg.json has one entry per heading (158 entries; matches the printed table of contents): id, number, title, level, pageStart, pageEnd, pdfUrl, file, text. `text` is the section's own text up to the next heading.
- Cite: always link the official PDF with a page fragment, e.g. https://static.googleusercontent.com/media/guidelines.raterhub.com/en//searchqualityevaluatorguidelines.pdf#page=26 for "3.4 Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trust (E-E-A-T)". Quote verbatim from the text files; do not cite this mirror as the source.
- Tables are GitHub Markdown tables in the Markdown files (cell paragraphs joined by <br>), and "Header: cell" lines in the text file.
- Screenshots and example images of the PDF are not included; links to them (guidelines.raterhub.com/images/...) are kept in the Markdown and HTML files.

## Full text

- [markdown/qrg.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/franzenzenhofer/google-search-quality-rater-guidelines/main/markdown/qrg.md): complete document as Markdown, headings mirror the numbering (# part, ## N.0, ### N.N, #### N.N.N)
- [text/qrg.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/franzenzenhofer/google-search-quality-rater-guidelines/main/text/qrg.txt): complete document as plain text
- [json/qrg.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/franzenzenhofer/google-search-quality-rater-guidelines/main/json/qrg.json): sections with page ranges and text
- [html/index.html](https://franzenzenhofer.github.io/google-search-quality-rater-guidelines/): one readable page with table of contents (GitHub Pages)
- [pdf/searchqualityevaluatorguidelines.pdf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/franzenzenhofer/google-search-quality-rater-guidelines/main/pdf/searchqualityevaluatorguidelines.pdf): unchanged copy of the official PDF
